_comment: Scripted model turns for the offline demo and the HTTP tests. Rules are tried in order against the latest user message; each step is one model turn. This is not a model: it makes no decisions.

args.sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS builds, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS failure_pct FROM builds b JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = b.program_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY failure_pct DESC

steps.text: Build failure rates per program are in the table, worst first.

args.sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS open_defects FROM defects d JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = d.program_id WHERE d.status <> 'closed' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY open_defects DESC

steps.text: Open defects per program are in the table. Row-level security limits this to the programs you can see.
